PullRequest.Title: agentHost: match signed-out BYOK models by id for automations (release 1.148)
PullRequest.Body:
Cherry-pick of #349937 onto `release/1.148`.

Signed-out BYOK models with configuration schemas are published as copies. Match models by id when checking automation readiness so these valid models can be used without Copilot authentication.

## Validation

- `pnpm run build-fast --client-only`
- `./scripts/test.sh --run src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/copilotAgent.test.ts --grep 'BYOK models make Copilot authentication optional without configuration'` (1 passing)

Scenarios.Scenario: Evaluate signed-out automation readiness for a selected BYOK model, including models copied during config-schema publication
Scenarios.CriticalPath: AgentHostAutomationService._scheduleNext filters automation templates through AgentService.isSessionTemplateAvailable and CopilotAgent.isReadyForAutomation; _startRun checks readiness again before allocating a session. The changed check synchronously scans already-published model arrays.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: A automation templates, M published models, and B BYOK models from one serving renderer; worst-case readiness work remains O(A*(M+B)) per availability reevaluation, plus checks when runs start.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Readiness checks execute synchronously in the agent-host process. There is no asynchronous fan-out or boundary call inside either predicate.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Both arrays are populated before the readiness check. Cold or absent catalogs return false without enumeration or fetching; warm catalogs are scanned locally. No new cache, invalidation, retained state, or failure retry is added.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: inspected the complete production diff, readiness implementation, publication copying, production caller, and automation scheduler/start paths.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Actual catalog and automation counts are not measured; no adverse scaling change is present.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable performance regression. some-by-ID replaces find-by-ID plus includes with the same two short-circuiting linear scans; the change corrects identity matching without adding collection passes or external work.

Scenarios.Scenario: Receive BYOK model snapshots, publish schema-bearing models, and remove models after disconnection or disablement
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The existing bridge change listener refreshes cached BYOK models and publishes the merged catalog. Published catalog changes can reevaluate automation availability. The diff changes only the subsequent membership test.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Receive renderer-pushed model snapshots and retain them for synchronous getModels reads.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One pushed snapshot per connection/model-change event; structurally equal snapshots are ignored. getModels selects one serving connection's catalog and does not enumerate models remotely per readiness check.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same push subscription, snapshot comparison, serving-window selection, cache, and model publication existed before this PR.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: An initial push supplies the local catalog needed for signed-out model readiness. Warm readiness checks perform no IPC.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: B models from a single serving renderer, rather than a union over all windows; existing publication also iterates live chat entries when synchronizing BYOK models.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Snapshot handling and catalog reads are synchronous; unchanged live-session synchronization is initiated only on catalog refresh, not by the changed readiness predicate.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The registry distinguishes no snapshot from an empty snapshot, caches snapshots, and removes entries and listeners on disposal. _byokModels and _models are replaced through existing publication paths; no lifecycle changes are introduced.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: traced the registry implementation, CopilotAgent bridge subscription, _refreshByokModels, _publishModels, and _withModelConfigAliases.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Snapshot frequency and live-session counts are unmeasured, but their work and scheduling are unchanged.
Scenarios.Verdict: No new enumeration, IPC fan-out, allocation lifecycle, or retention mechanism. Snapshot publication and removal are unchanged.

Scenarios.Scenario: Start a due or manual automation using a signed-out BYOK model that has a configuration schema
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Once readiness succeeds, _startRun follows the existing allocateSession, durable running-state mutation, createSession, link-session mutation, and startSession sequence. These are execution prerequisites, not work performed for each model candidate.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Check candidate session data-directory existence while selecting a new session URI.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Normally one existence check per newly allocated session; additional checks only for candidate collisions. No model-count multiplier.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Unchanged allocation path was already reachable for authenticated automations and signed-out BYOK models without copied schemas. Copied-schema BYOK models were incorrectly blocked before allocation; this PR intentionally enables their requested execution.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Completes before a new automation session is allocated.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Prepare session storage and record default-chat storage identity before provider chat creation.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One existing storage-preparation sequence per newly created session; not per readiness check or model.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Same session-creation implementation and storage work; newly reachable only because valid schema-bearing signed-out selections now pass readiness.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Existing prerequisite to creating a runnable session.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: R eligible pending runs. Allocation and session creation occur once per run that needs a new session, not once per catalog model. Existing previous-session targets can reuse sessions.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: _startingRuns prevents duplicate starts per run; durable mutations are serialized through _mutationTail. Different runs may start concurrently, while previous-session starts are sequenced per automation. None of these concurrency rules changes.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Readiness uses cached catalogs. Existing SDK-client acquisition reuses _client and coalesces in-flight startup through _ensureClientHealing/_clientStarting; the PR does not change those caches or startup scheduling.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High for the changed readiness gate and traced scheduler/allocation/storage sequence; downstream execution machinery is unchanged.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Pending-run counts and execution durations are unmeasured. Expected work from newly functioning automations does not independently establish a regression.
Scenarios.Verdict: Enabling the requested automation execution is not an actionable performance regression. No redundant starts, per-model boundary calls, defeated coalescing, or changed concurrency policy is introduced.

Scenarios.Scenario: Check readiness while authenticated, using a Microsoft account context, with no selected model, or after a model disappears
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Existing account/authentication guards return before the changed membership expression where applicable; missing selected IDs short-circuit at the published-model scan.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Constant-time existing account/authentication checks; at most M published-model comparisons for a missing ID.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Synchronous local checks with unchanged observable dependencies.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Account, authentication, and catalog values are observable local state; the changed expression initiates no authentication refresh, model fetch, or negative-cache retry.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: direct comparison of the complete changed method and associated test cases.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Static review only; no timing measurements.
Scenarios.Verdict: No performance regression or new work on authenticated/startup-negative paths.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance-review pass across the full two-file inventory and every diff page against base dec73890cb0bc7fd437520dbc7e74c55df259cd3. No high-confidence performance regressions found. The production change preserves linear local readiness checks and fixes object-identity matching; test expansion adds no production work. No concrete removed performance regression warranted blame provenance or regression-fix reporting.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
